title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 27, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.7)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.2 (Peaked October 27, 2026 at 17:46 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 400 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The space around Earth is getting a little energetic! 🌎⚡📡🔋

A broad dark coronal-hole-like region stands out alongside several modest bright active regions; no clear large coronagraphic eruption is visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
